meta_description: LS6 Electrical in Leeds provides domestic and commercial electrical work. Part P certified. Same-day callouts available. Call Jamie on 07814 962299.
hero_eyebrow: Part P Certified — Same-Day Callouts Available
hero_subhead: Faulty wiring, blown circuits, or a complete rewire? LS6 Electrical diagnoses and fixes electrical faults fast, with no unnecessary delays.
services_subhead: From emergency callouts to full house rewires, we handle every electrical job to Building Regulations standards.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Blown fuses, tripped circuits, or dead sockets? We diagnose faults quickly and carry common parts on the van for same-day fixes.

services.title: Domestic Rewiring
services.desc: Old wiring posing a fire risk? We replace outdated systems with modern, safe installations, fully tested and certified under Part P.

services.title: Consumer Unit Installation & Upgrades
services.desc: Aged fuse boxes can cause trip-outs and safety hazards. We install modern consumer units with RCD protection and surge protection.

services.title: New Lighting & Socket Installation
services.desc: Adding sockets for a kitchen extension or updating room lighting? We plan layouts to code and install fixtures that work reliably.

services.title: Electrical Testing & Inspections
services.desc: Periodic Inspection Reports (PIRs) keep older properties safe and are often required by landlords. We test all circuits and report findings.

services.title: Commercial Electrical Work
services.desc: Office rewires, new circuits for equipment, and routine maintenance for small businesses. Full compliance with commercial Building Regulations.

about_pullquote: I fix electrical problems properly — no shortcuts, no return visits.
about_para_1: Jamie founded LS6 Electrical in 2013 after years working on larger construction sites. He saw too many cowboys cutting corners and overcharging homeowners for simple jobs. He set up to offer honest, straightforward electrical work for domestic and small commercial customers across Leeds. Every job is done to Building Regulations, with full Part P certification and testing.
about_para_2: Customers return to LS6 Electrical because Jamie listens, explains what needs doing, and quotes fair prices before starting work. He carries common parts, so most jobs are finished in one visit. He's based in Meanwood and knows the LS6–LS8 area inside out, which means quick callouts and genuine local knowledge of older properties and their quirks.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Customers Say About LS6 Electrical

reviews.text: Jamie came out on a Saturday morning when our kitchen went dark. Within 20 minutes he'd found the fault in the consumer unit and had us back on. Proper quick service and fair price. Will use him again.
reviews.author: Mark H.

reviews.text: We'd been putting off a full rewire because we thought it would cost the earth. Jamie gave a honest quote, explained exactly what he'd do, and the work was finished in three days. No mess, no faffing. Brilliant.
reviews.author: Patricia D.

reviews.text: Had a dodgy socket that sparked. Phoned Jamie mid-morning, he was here by lunchtime and sorted it. Really professional, puts your mind at ease. Not trying to sell you things you don't need either.
reviews.author: David L.
